subject: Request for red-team assessment report and scope clarification
messages:
From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldbio.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: brian.lewis@greenfieldbio.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Hi Marissa,

Following the anomalous authentication events we discussed on Friday, Greenfield's security team is requesting the most recent red-team/penetration assessment report you have that touches session management and token handling. We need: an executive summary, the scope (targets and exclusions), and a remediation status summary for high/critical findings.

We understand there may be NDA/third-party constraints — if you can't share the full report, could you provide a redacted executive summary and a remediation tracker? We also need expected timelines for any remaining open items. This is to support an internal risk brief for the board tomorrow.

Please treat this as high priority. If it helps, I'm available for a 30-minute call this morning.

Thanks,
Sara Kim
Security Lead, Greenfield Biotech
---
Attachment requested: executive summary or redacted report

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldbio.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 28 Feb 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and flag. I appreciate the urgency.

Short answer: we can share an executive summary and a remediation tracker for the November 2025 red-team exercise. A few quick notes up front:
- The full raw report contains test vectors and third-party contractor details that are covered by our contract and cannot be shared verbatim.
- We can provide a redacted PDF (exec summary + scope + redacted findings) and a separate remediation tracker that lists open items, severity, and owner.
- Timeline: we can have the redacted exec summary and tracker to you by EOD Monday PT (Mar 1). If you need a less redacted copy, we'll need a data-sharing addendum — I can put you in touch with Legal immediately.

Looping in Neha from Security to confirm the redaction approach and provide the tracker.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: proposed file names (redacted exec summary + tracker)

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldbio.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 08:35:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Sara / Marissa — quick update from Security:

We ran the redaction pass this morning. Deliverables we can share without additional legal approvals: 
1) redteam-exec-summary-2025-11.pdf — contains scope, targets tested, high-level findings (no test payloads, no contractor PII).
2) remediation-tracker-20260228.xlsx — lists findings (ID, severity, status, owner, ETA).

High-level remediation status for the items you care about:
- TOKEN-14 (critical): root cause identified (JWT refresh race condition). Patch deployed to staging 2026-02-20; production rollout scheduled for 2026-03-05. Compensating control (short TTL rotation + additional monitoring) applied 2026-02-22.
- SESSION-7 (high): session fixation vector mitigated with cookie flags; monitoring rule in place.
- LOG-3 (medium): improvement planned as part of March logging sprint.

We'll attach the redacted documents to this thread. If Greenfield needs the unredacted report under an NDA or DSA, Legal will coordinate.

-Neha
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: redteam-exec-summary-2025-11.pdf (redacted), remediation-tracker-20260228.xlsx

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldbio.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: brian.lewis@greenfieldbio.com
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Thanks Neha — this is very helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs from our reviewers: 
1) For TOKEN-14, can you confirm whether the patch includes a deterministic fix at the token issuance path or whether it's a mitigation that relies on monitoring? Our compliance team is asking whether user re-auth is required.
2) For the remediation tracker ETAs, are the dates gated on any cross-team dependencies (infra, SRE)?

Also, we have an internal process that requires a secondary attestation from the vendor for critical fixes. Can Redwood provide a short note confirming that TOKEN-14 will have the production fix deployed and validated (smoke tests + canary) by 2026-03-05? If Legal needs to push a DSA for the unredacted report, we'll expedite.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Sara

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@greenfieldbio.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Sara — short attestation below; we will follow up with validation evidence once canary completes.

Vendor attestation (TOKEN-14):
- Fix type: deterministic code fix to token refresh logic in auth service (no manual mitigation required post-deploy).
- Deployment plan: canary on 5% traffic 2026-03-04 02:00 PT, full rollout 2026-03-05 04:00 PT, rollback window: 2 hours.
- Validation: smoke tests + integration tests in canary; additional synthetic transaction checks post-rollout.
- Expected impact: negligible user-visible downtime; no forced re-auth for existing sessions.

We will provide a short validation summary (canary logs + smoke test output) within 24 hours of full rollout. If Greenfield prefers, we can also sign a quick attestation doc for your records.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Director, Product Security, Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: none (validation evidence to follow)

From: Brian Lewis <brian.lewis@greenfieldbio.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: red-team assessment report and remediation status

Marissa / Neha — quick note from Greenfield leadership: thank you for the attestation. We will plan to accept the redacted exec summary and the remediation tracker for the board briefing contingent on receiving the post-rollout validation summary. If the validation summary is not available within 24 hours of the rollout, we will request an escalation to provide more detailed evidence.

Please confirm the best contact for any follow-up and whether Redwood needs Greenfield to sign any additional paperwork to obtain the unredacted report.

Thanks,
Brian Lewis
